production.note: US model years 2007-2009 at 500 hp. Ford's 2007 brochure (ford-mustang-2007-brochure), 2008 brochure (ford-mustang-2008-brochure) and 2009 brochure (ford-mustang-2009-brochure) each list the Shelby GT500 at '500 hp @ 6000 rpm'. Excluded: Ford's 2010 brochure lists the GT500 at '540 hp @ 6000 rpm and 510 lb.-ft. of torque @ 4500 rpm' (ford-mustang-2010-brochure), an 8% higher rating with the facelifted body, so 2010 onward is a different rating and is not covered here (2011-2012 brochure could not be opened: HTTP 429). The 2013-2014 5.8-liter car is its own record (ford-mustang-shelby-gt500-s197-2013-2014).

body.note: Ford's 2009 brochure lists 'Shelby GT500 Coupe' and 'Shelby GT500 Convertible'. The standard car is the coupe.

displacementL.note: Ford: '5.4L'. 5,409 cc: Steve Turner, FordMuscle, '330 cu. in./5,409 cc' (fordmuscle-turner-gt500-2007); ConceptCarz: '5409 cc | 330.1 cu in. | 5.4 L.' (conceptcarz-gt500-2007).

drivetrain.note: Edmunds: 'A Tremec six-speed manual gearbox routes all that through a 3.31 limited-slip rear axle.' Front engine, rear-wheel drive.

transmission.note: 'TREMEC 6-speed manual transmission', the only transmission (2009 brochure: '6-speed manual transmission').

powerHp.note: Ford 2007 Mustang brochure. Quote: "500 hp @ 6000 rpm and 480 lb.-ft. of torque @ 4500 rpm". Same in the 2008 brochure ("500 hp @ 6000 rpm and 480 lb.-ft. of torque @ 4500 rpm", ford-mustang-2008-brochure) and the 2009 brochure ("5.4L supercharged, intercooled DOHC V8 500 hp @ 6000 rpm; 480 lb.-ft. of torque @ 4500 rpm", ford-mustang-2009-brochure). A pre-launch article gave an estimated 475 hp (fordmuscle-turner-gt500-2007, 'Estimated: 475 (SAE net)'), superseded by Ford's published 500 hp.

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL (single named-author article, backed by an unbylined review and databases). Coupe, 6-speed manual (the only transmission); the article's spec panel gives the coupe base price ($41,295). Quote (The Auto Channel, Rex Roy, 5 Jan 2007, spec panel): "Curb weight: 3920 lb". Edmunds' unbylined review (edmunds-gt500-2007-review): "Ford lists the Shelby GT500's curb weight at 3,920 pounds in coupe form and 4,040 pounds for the convertible." Database: Encycarpedia 2007 coupe 'Curb Weight: 3,920 lbs' (encycarpedia-gt500-2007). ConceptCarz prints the same figure labelled only 'Weight' ('3920 lbs | 1778.082 kg', conceptcarz-gt500-2007), an unlabelled figure that is not counted as a curb weight. A Jan 2006 pre-launch article gave '~3,920 lbs Coupe' (fordmuscle-turner-gt500-2007). No Ford page with the figure was opened, and only one named-author outlet prints it.

provisionalNote: Weight (3,920 lb, coupe, manual) rests on one named-author article's spec panel (The Auto Channel, Rex Roy), with Edmunds' unbylined review stating Ford lists 3,920 lb and one database (Encycarpedia) agreeing; ConceptCarz's same figure is labelled only 'Weight' and is not counted. A Ford 2007-2009 specification sheet or press kit, or a major magazine spec panel (Car and Driver, Road & Track, MotorTrend), would replace it. Power (500 hp) is from Ford's 2007-2009 brochures.
